dsh-plugin-local-life is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Local-life toolkit for DSH agents: budget planning, bill splitting, unit-price and discount math, common unit conversions (jin/li/chi, C/F, L/gallon), and trip checklists.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-1453654a6bd814a93ea9.html
